decisions.reason: As a close-to-core lighting product launched only in 2023, with no visible sign of withdrawal and with the firm operating a broad range in a growing industry, management would likely retain it because performance is still too uncertain to judge below aspiration and available slack favors continued market learning.

Because this ceiling luminaire is also an incremental extension of the established offer, and there is no evidence of a clear shortfall against aspiration while the firm emphasizes breadth, service, and sustainable growth, management would likely keep it on the market rather than redeploy resources immediately.
